t: This is the Working Men's College in Somers Town, among the earliest adult education institutions in the United Kingdom and Europe's oldest surviving centre for adult education. It was founded by Christian socialists, with F. D. Maurice, an Anglican priest and theologian, among the founders of Christian socialism, as the founder. At its start it was at the forefront of liberal education thinking. The architect William Douglas Caroe designed the building. Today the college has two centres in Camden.
